description: This Java class 'DelegatorEcaHandler' implements entity event condition actions (ECA) handling in the OFBiz framework. It manages rules for entity events, handles concurrent dispatch context retrieval, and evaluates rules based on entity events.

classes.name: DelegatorEcaHandler
classes.description: A handler for entity event condition actions (ECA) that manages and evaluates rules for specific entities within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator instance and initializes related fields, including preloading the ECA cache and dispatch context asynchronously.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Retrieves the dispatch context, waiting for its initialization if necessary, handling concurrency and exceptions.

methods.name: getEntityEventMap
methods.description: Returns the map of event names to lists of rules for a given entity.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates a set of rules associated with a specific entity event, executing them accordingly.
